name: novasuite
description: NovaSuite PTC – Telegraf bot (Railway) + Next.js Admin CMS (Vercel) + one PostgreSQL

scripts.db:migrate: cd database && npm install && node migrate.js
scripts.bot: cd bot && npm install && node bot.js
scripts.bot:dev: cd bot && npm install && npx nodemon bot.js
scripts.cms:dev: cd cms && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.cms:build: cd cms && npm install && npm run build
